agsFile.title: Silvertown mini
agsFile.description: Small AGSi 1.0.1 package with a 2D section model linked to a plan alignment.
agsFile.remarks: Test fixture: trimmed excerpt of the AGSi 1.0.1 conversion of the published AGSi example 'Silvertown2D_wkt_1.agsi'. Only the first 6 vertices of the NB alignment and of three section profiles are kept (verbatim full-precision coordinates), and only two model elements.

agsProjectCoordinateSystem.description: 2D vertical section along alignment NB: X = chainage along the alignment, Z = elevation
agsProjectCoordinateSystem.remarks: Chainage is measured along agsiModelAlignment 'NB' (startChainage 0). Vertical datum is not stated in the source package; elevations are retained as supplied and no vertical system is asserted.

The source package states no coordinate reference system. EPSG:27700 (British National Grid) is inferred: coordinates E 539k / N 179-181k transform to 51.495N 0.005E (Greenwich Peninsula portal) and 51.508N 0.013E (Silvertown portal) of the Silvertown Tunnel. axisUnitsZ is required by the schema but unused by this XY system.

agsiModel.remarks: Section model; its alignmentID 'NB' refers to the agsiModelAlignment in the plan model.

agsiModel.description: 2D map (XY) model holding the NB section alignment referenced by the NB section model (agsiModel alignmentID 'NB').
agsiModel.usage: Defines the plan alignment of the section model only; contains no model elements.

agsiModelAlignment.description: Plan (XY) alignment of the NB section, Silvertown Tunnel

agsiGeometry.remarks: First 6 XY vertices (full precision) of the NB alignment of the converted Silvertown package.

agsiModelAlignment.remarks: Vertex i of every section profile corresponds to vertex i of this alignment (6 vertices); the profile chainage equals the cumulative XY length of this alignment at every vertex.
